card.name: Stop use / do not use warnings
card.fires_on: The word right after a stop or do-not-use phrase in warning text, such as 'use' after Stop or Discontinue, or 'if' after Do not use. Also 'persist' after 'If symptoms'.

modes.label: Use after stop
modes.description: The word 'use' completing 'Stop use' or 'Discontinue use' in a warnings section.
modes.example: Discontinue<< use>> if severe symptoms develop.

modes.label: If after do not use
modes.description: The word 'if' or 'si' after 'Do not use' introducing a condition such as a broken seal.

modes.description: The word 'persist' after 'If symptoms' in over-the-counter directions.
